checks.rule: A release reaching the window clears steering without cancelling Gas
checks.input: Press Gas with pointer1 and Right with pointer2; deliver pointerup2 only to the window.
checks.expected: Right false, Gas true; releasing pointer1 leaves no holds.

checks.rule: A shared input reset cannot resurrect an old hold after a fresh tap
checks.input: Press Right2; reset shared actions; sync; press/release a new Right3.
checks.expected: No active pointer tokens or Right command after the new release.

checks.rule: Cancellation, lifecycle loss and disabled input clear private ownership
checks.input: For each of pointercancel, blur, pagehide, freeze, document hidden, disabled and unfocused: hold Gas+Right and interrupt.
checks.expected: All holds/actions clear; re-enabling input and tapping cannot restore an old command.

checks.rule: Thousands of rapid taps leave no stale steering while another finger holds Gas
checks.input: Gas pointer1 held;5000 Right down/up pairs with changing IDs; all releases delivered globally.
checks.expected: Right false after every tap, Gas true until its own release; no token accumulation.

checks.rule: Each pointer has one owner and one finger ending cannot release another
checks.input: Press Right with two pointers; release one; transfer the other to Left; deliver a delayed Right capture loss.
checks.expected: Right persists until its last contact ends; transferred Left remains active; final release clears it.

checks.rule: A delayed old capture loss does not cancel a newly captured contact with a reused ID
checks.input: Press/release Right7; press Right7 again; deliver an old loss while the new capture is active.
checks.expected: New Right remains held until the current pointerup.

checks.rule: A failed capture and a genuinely lost capture have safe release paths
checks.input: Throw from setPointerCapture then release globally; separately lose a real capture.
checks.expected: No exception/stuck action; both paths clear ownership.

checks.rule: Long holds have no automatic expiry and repeated key events do not accumulate
checks.input: Keep pointer42 held across10000 sync calls; then repeat Space/Enter keydown and release each separately/global keyup.
checks.expected: Long hold remains valid until release; both keyboard tokens are tracked independently and fully clear.

checks.rule: Button blur clears keyboard ownership and disposal removes all event handlers
checks.input: Hold button Space and a pointer; blur the button, then dispose and dispatch new events.
checks.expected: Blur cancels its key but preserves its contact; disposal clears all holds and later events do nothing.

checks.rule: The ownership ledger rejects unknown buttons/IDs and returns immutable snapshots
checks.input: Unknown button,negative/fractional ID,duplicate names; mutate returned diagnostics.
checks.expected: Invalid ownership rejected; snapshots cannot mutate active internal state.

checks.rule: Native touch release clears only ended buttons even if pointerup is missing
checks.input: Hold Gas1 and Right2; deliver only touchend with Gas still in touches, then touchend with no touches.
checks.expected: Right releases, Gas remains held; final touch release clears all contacts.

checks.rule: Touch fallback preserves a second finger and keyboard hold on the same button
checks.input: Two Right contacts plus Space; one contact remains during touchend, then all contacts end, then keyup.
checks.expected: Right stays held while any valid contact/key remains; final keyboard release clears it.

checks.rule: Touch cancellation cannot leave an old contact attached to the next tap
checks.input: Cancel a Right contact through touchcancel only, then start/release a fresh Right contact.
checks.expected: No old pointer token returns after the new release.

checks.rule: Mouse steering ends when the primary button is no longer held
checks.input: Hold primary mouse on Right, move with primary held, then miss pointerup and move with no primary button; separately try a secondary click.
checks.expected: Primary hold persists correctly; buttons0/secondary-only movement releases it; a secondary click cannot activate driving.
